title: Onomancy
summary: ON'OMANCY, noun [Gr. name, and divination.] Divination by the letters of a name. Destinies were superstitiously, by onomancy deciphered out of names.

inlines.v: ON'OMANCY, noun [Gr. name, and divination.] Divination by the letters of a name. Destinies were superstitiously, by onomancy deciphered out of names.
